name: Spirit
summary: A solar-powered rover planned for 90 sols that worked for six years and found signs of past water, until it got stuck in soft sand.
discoveries: Found signs that water once altered rocks and soil in Gusev crater.

stories.kids: I was built for a 90-day job and I stayed for six years. I found clues that water once changed the ground here. In 2009 I got stuck in soft sand, and in 2010 my last message reached Earth.
stories.explorer: Spirit explored Gusev crater from January 2004. In 2009 it became stuck in sand, and NASA’s last contact with it was March 22, 2010. Recovery efforts ended in May 2011.
stories.scientist: Spirit landed in Gusev crater on January 4, 2004 (UTC), with a planned primary mission of 90 sols. It became embedded in soft soil in 2009; last communication was March 22, 2010 and recovery attempts ended on May 25, 2011.

image.alt: Wide-angle view across the deck of the Spirit rover on Mars, taken by the rover’s own camera.

clues.prompt: What clue did I find in Gusev crater?
options: Signs that water once changed the rocks and soil
clues.explain: The rocks and soil showed signs of past water activity.

clues.prompt: What stopped me from moving in 2009?
options: I got stuck in soft sand
clues.explain: I became stuck in soft soil in 2009, and I’m solar-powered, so there was no fuel to run out.

timeline.title: Landing in Gusev crater
timeline.text: Spirit begins a mission planned for 90 sols.

timeline.title: Stuck in soft sand
timeline.text: Spirit becomes embedded in soft soil and cannot drive free.

timeline.title: Last contact
timeline.text: NASA’s last communication with Spirit arrives on March 22, 2010.

timeline.title: Recovery efforts end
timeline.text: After many attempts to free the rover, NASA ends recovery efforts.

learn.title: Who I am
learn.text: I’m Spirit, a solar-powered rover. I landed in Gusev crater on January 4, 2004, for a mission planned to last 90 sols.

learn.title: What I found
learn.text: My instruments found signs that water once changed the rocks and soil of Gusev crater.

learn.title: What happened
learn.text: In 2009 I became stuck in soft sand and couldn’t drive free. NASA’s last contact with me was on March 22, 2010. I run on sunlight, so I never had fuel to run out of.
